info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Retrieve Credit Margin Model API provides access to credit margin models based on a specified parameter. This API is designed for financial institutions and developers looking to obtain specific credit margin details used in banking applications. It allows users to fetch precise model information using the unique identifier, enhancing decision-making processes related to credit assessments. Typical consumers include banking software developers and data analysts focused on financial modeling.

get.summary: Retrieve credit margin details by resource ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific credit margin identified by its unique resource ID. Use this to obtain data related to credit margin calculations and associated attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the credit margin information for the specified model. It contains necessary parameters that define the query for the credit margins associated with the model ID 'RES-100045'.
